passages.text: A Maskil of Ethan the Ezrahite.
passages.sermon: Ethan the Ezrahite wrote this song.\r\nThis song is a Maskil.\r\nA Maskil is a wise or instructive poem.

passages.text: I will sing of the loving devotion of the LORD forever; with my mouth I will proclaim Your faithfulness to all generations.
passages.sermon:
Ethan the Ezrahite wrote this song.
Ethan was wise.
I will sing about the LORD’s loving devotion.
I will sing forever.
I will use my mouth to proclaim God’s faithfulness.
I will tell every generation about God’s faithfulness.
passages.original: מַ֝שְׂכִּ֗יל לְאֵיתָ֥ן הָֽאֶזְרָחִֽי׃ חַֽסְדֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה עוֹלָ֣ם אָשִׁ֑ירָה לְדֹ֥ר וָדֹ֓ר׀ אוֹדִ֖יעַ אֱמוּנָתְךָ֣ בְּפִֽי׃

passages.text: For I have said, “Loving devotion is built up forever; in the heavens You establish Your faithfulness.”
passages.sermon:
Ethan the Ezrahite speaks this psalm.
Ethan says, “God’s loving devotion lasts forever.
God builds loving devotion so it stands always.
God establishes His faithfulness in the heavens.
God’s faithfulness is firm and unchanging above.”
passages.original: כִּֽי־ אָמַ֗רְתִּי ע֭וֹלָם חֶ֣סֶד יִבָּנֶ֑ה שָׁמַ֓יִם׀ תָּכִ֖ן אֱמוּנָתְךָ֣ בָהֶֽם׃

passages.text: You said, “I have made a covenant with My chosen one, I have sworn to David My servant: ‘I will establish your offspring forever and build up your throne for all generations.’ ” Selah The heavens praise Your wonders, O LORD— Your faithfulness as well— in the assembly of the holy ones.
passages.sermon:
God spoke.
God chose David.
God made a covenant with David.
God called David His servant.
God swore an oath to David.
God promised to establish David’s descendants forever.
God promised to build up David’s throne for all generations.
The heavens praise God’s wonders.
The LORD’s faithfulness is also praised.
The assembly of the holy ones praises God’s faithfulness.
passages.original: כָּרַ֣תִּֽי בְ֭רִית לִבְחִירִ֑י נִ֝שְׁבַּ֗עְתִּי לְדָוִ֥ד עַבְדִּֽי׃ עַד־ ע֭וֹלָם אָכִ֣ין זַרְעֶ֑ךָ וּבָנִ֨יתִי לְדֹר־ וָד֖וֹר כִּסְאֲךָ֣ סֶֽלָה׃ וְי֘וֹד֤וּ שָׁמַ֣יִם פִּלְאֲךָ֣ יְהוָ֑ה אַף־ אֱ֝מֽוּנָתְךָ֗ בִּקְהַ֥ל קְדֹשִֽׁים׃

passages.text: For who in the skies can compare with the LORD? Who among the heavenly beings is like the LORD?
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
He is above all.
No one in the skies can compare with the LORD.
No heavenly being is like the LORD.
God stands alone in greatness.
passages.original: כִּ֤י מִ֣י בַ֭שַּׁחַק יַעֲרֹ֣ךְ לַיהוָ֑ה יִדְמֶ֥ה לַ֝יהוָ֗ה בִּבְנֵ֥י אֵלִים׃

passages.text: In the council of the holy ones, God is greatly feared, and awesome above all who surround Him.
passages.sermon:
God sits among the holy ones.
God is greatly feared there.
God is awesome above all who surround Him.
No one near God is as great as He is.
God’s power and greatness cause fear and awe among the holy ones.
passages.original: אֵ֣ל נַ֭עֲרָץ בְּסוֹד־ קְדֹשִׁ֣ים רַבָּ֑ה וְ֝נוֹרָ֗א עַל־ כָּל־ סְבִיבָֽיו׃

passages.text: O LORD God of Hosts, who is like You? O mighty LORD, Your faithfulness surrounds You.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God of Hosts.
The LORD is mighty.
No one is like the LORD.
The LORD’s faithfulness surrounds Him.
passages.original: יְהוָ֤ה׀ אֱלֹ֘הֵ֤י צְבָא֗וֹת מִֽי־ כָֽמ֖וֹךָ חֲסִ֥ין׀ יָ֑הּ וֶ֝אֱמֽוּנָתְךָ֗ סְבִיבוֹתֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: You rule the raging sea; when its waves mount up, You still them.
passages.sermon:
God rules the sea.
The sea rages.
God controls the sea.
The waves rise high.
God makes the waves quiet.
passages.original: אַתָּ֣ה מ֭וֹשֵׁל בְּגֵא֣וּת הַיָּ֑ם בְּשׂ֥וֹא גַ֝לָּ֗יו אַתָּ֥ה תְשַׁבְּחֵֽם׃

passages.text: You crushed Rahab like a carcass; You scattered Your enemies with Your mighty arm.
passages.sermon:
The LORD God of Hosts is mighty.
The LORD crushed Rahab like a dead body.
The LORD used His strong arm.
The LORD scattered His enemies.
passages.original: אַתָּ֤ה דִכִּ֣אתָ כֶחָלָ֣ל רָ֑הַב בִּזְר֥וֹעַ עֻ֝זְּךָ֗ פִּזַּ֥רְתָּ אוֹיְבֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: The heavens are Yours, and also the earth. The earth and its fullness You founded.
passages.sermon:
God owns the heavens.
God owns the earth.
God made the earth.
God made everything in the earth.
passages.original: לְךָ֣ שָׁ֭מַיִם אַף־ לְךָ֥ אָ֑רֶץ תֵּבֵ֥ל וּ֝מְלֹאָ֗הּ אַתָּ֥ה יְסַדְתָּֽם׃

passages.text: North and south You created; Tabor and Hermon shout for joy at Your name.
passages.sermon:
God created the north.
God created the south.
God made Tabor.
God made Hermon.
Tabor praises God’s name.
Hermon praises God’s name.
passages.original: צָפ֣וֹן וְ֭יָמִין אַתָּ֣ה בְרָאתָ֑ם תָּב֥וֹר וְ֝חֶרְמ֗וֹן בְּשִׁמְךָ֥ יְרַנֵּֽנוּ׃

passages.text: Mighty is Your arm; strong is Your hand. Your right hand is exalted.
passages.sermon:
God is mighty.
God has a powerful arm.
God has a strong hand.
God’s right hand is lifted high.
God’s right hand is honored.
passages.original: לְךָ֣ זְ֭רוֹעַ עִם־ גְּבוּרָ֑ה תָּעֹ֥ז יָ֝דְךָ֗ תָּר֥וּם יְמִינֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of Your throne; loving devotion and faithfulness go before You.
passages.sermon:
God rules over all creation.
God’s throne stands on righteousness.
God’s throne stands on justice.
Loving devotion goes before God.
Faithfulness goes before God.
passages.original: צֶ֣דֶק וּ֭מִשְׁפָּט מְכ֣וֹן כִּסְאֶ֑ךָ חֶ֥סֶד וֶ֝אֱמֶ֗ת יְֽקַדְּמ֥וּ פָנֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: Blessed are those who know the joyful sound, who walk, O LORD, in the light of Your presence.
passages.sermon:
This passage speaks about the people who know God and live in His presence.
These people are blessed.
They know the joyful sound.
They walk in the light of the LORD’s presence.
God’s presence gives them light.
They live with God’s guidance and blessing.
passages.original: אַשְׁרֵ֣י הָ֭עָם יוֹדְעֵ֣י תְרוּעָ֑ה יְ֝הוָ֗ה בְּֽאוֹר־ פָּנֶ֥יךָ יְהַלֵּכֽוּן׃

passages.text: They rejoice in Your name all day long, and in Your righteousness they exult.
passages.sermon: God’s people rejoice in God’s name.\r\nThey rejoice all day long.\r\nGod’s people exult in God’s righteousness.
passages.original: בְּ֭שִׁמְךָ יְגִיל֣וּן כָּל־ הַיּ֑וֹם וּבְצִדְקָתְךָ֥ יָרֽוּמוּ׃

passages.text: For You are the glory of their strength, and by Your favor our horn is exalted.
passages.sermon:
God gives His people strength.
God is the glory of their strength.
God shows favor to His people.
By God's favor, He lifts up their power.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ תִפְאֶ֣רֶת עֻזָּ֣מוֹ אָ֑תָּה וּ֝בִרְצֹנְךָ֗ תָּרִים קַרְנֵֽנוּ׃

passages.text: Surely our shield belongs to the LORD, and our king to the Holy One of Israel.
passages.sermon:
The LORD protects us.
He is our shield.
The Holy One of Israel is our king.
Our king belongs to Him.
passages.original: כִּ֣י לַֽ֭יהוָה מָֽגִנֵּ֑נוּ וְלִקְד֖וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל מַלְכֵּֽנוּ׃

passages.text: You once spoke in a vision; to Your godly ones You said, “I have bestowed help on a warrior; I have exalted one chosen from the people.
passages.sermon:
God spoke in a vision.
God spoke to His faithful people.
God said, “I have given help to a strong man.
I have lifted up a chosen person from among the people.”
passages.original: אָ֤ז דִּבַּ֥רְתָּֽ־ בְחָ֡זוֹן לַֽחֲסִידֶ֗יךָ וַתֹּ֗אמֶר שִׁוִּ֣יתִי עֵ֭זֶר עַל־ גִּבּ֑וֹר הֲרִימ֖וֹתִי בָח֣וּר מֵעָֽם׃

passages.text: I have found My servant David; with My sacred oil I have anointed him.
passages.sermon:
God speaks in this passage.
God says, "I have found David."
David is My servant.
I have anointed David.
I used My sacred oil to anoint him.
passages.original: מָ֭צָאתִי דָּוִ֣ד עַבְדִּ֑י בְּשֶׁ֖מֶן קָדְשִׁ֣י מְשַׁחְתִּֽיו׃

passages.text: My hand will sustain him; surely My arm will strengthen him.
passages.sermon:
God speaks about David.
God says, “My hand will stay with David.
My hand will support David.
My arm will make David strong.”
passages.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָ֭דִי תִּכּ֣וֹן עִמּ֑וֹ אַף־ זְרוֹעִ֥י תְאַמְּצֶֽנּוּ׃

passages.text: No enemy will exact tribute; no wicked man will oppress him.
passages.sermon:
God chose David as His servant.
God anointed David with sacred oil.
No enemy will force David to pay tribute.
No wicked man will oppress David.
passages.original: לֹֽא־ יַשִּׁ֣א אוֹיֵ֣ב בּ֑וֹ וּבֶן־ עַ֝וְלָ֗ה לֹ֣א יְעַנֶּֽנּוּ׃

passages.text: I will crush his foes before him and strike down those who hate him.
passages.sermon:
God speaks about the king He has chosen.
God promises to act with power.
God will crush the king’s enemies in front of him.
God will strike down everyone who hates the king.
passages.original: וְכַתּוֹתִ֣י מִפָּנָ֣יו צָרָ֑יו וּמְשַׂנְאָ֥יו אֶגּֽוֹף׃

passages.text: My faithfulness and loving devotion will be with him, and through My name his horn will be exalted.
passages.sermon:
God speaks about His chosen servant.
God says, "My faithfulness will be with him."
My loving devotion will be with him.
My name will lift up his strength.
My name will make him great.
passages.original: וֶֽאֶֽמוּנָתִ֣י וְחַסְדִּ֣י עִמּ֑וֹ וּ֝בִשְׁמִ֗י תָּר֥וּם קַרְנֽוֹ׃

passages.text: I will set his hand over the sea, and his right hand upon the rivers.
passages.sermon:
God speaks about His chosen king.
God says, "I will give him great power."
I will place his hand over the sea.
I will place his right hand on the rivers.
He will rule over the sea.
He will rule over the rivers.
passages.original: וְשַׂמְתִּ֣י בַיָּ֣ם יָד֑וֹ וּֽבַנְּהָר֥וֹת יְמִינֽוֹ׃

passages.text: He will call to Me, ‘You are my Father, my God, the Rock of my salvation.’
passages.sermon:
God speaks about a chosen king.
This king will speak to God.
He will call out to God.
He will say, “You are my Father.”
He will say, “You are my God.”
He will say, “You are the Rock of my salvation.”
passages.original: ה֣וּא יִ֭קְרָאֵנִי אָ֣בִי אָ֑תָּה אֵ֝לִ֗י וְצ֣וּר יְשׁוּעָתִֽי׃

passages.text: I will indeed appoint him as My firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.
passages.sermon:
God speaks about His chosen one.
God says, "I will make him My firstborn."
He will be the highest among all the kings on earth.
God gives him this special honor and authority.
passages.original: אַף־ אָ֭נִי בְּכ֣וֹר אֶתְּנֵ֑הוּ עֶ֝לְי֗וֹן לְמַלְכֵי־ אָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: I will forever preserve My loving devotion for him, and My covenant with him will stand fast.
passages.sermon: God speaks about His chosen one.\r\nGod promises to keep His loving devotion for him forever.\r\nGod says His covenant with him will always remain firm.
passages.original: לְ֭עוֹלָ֗ם אֶשְׁמוֹר ל֣וֹ חַסְדִּ֑י וּ֝בְרִיתִ֗י נֶאֱמֶ֥נֶת לֽוֹ׃

passages.text: I will establish his line forever, his throne as long as the heavens endure.
passages.sermon: God speaks about His chosen one.\r\nGod promises to establish his descendants forever.\r\nGod will make his throne last as long as the heavens exist.
passages.original: וְשַׂמְתִּ֣י לָעַ֣ד זַרְע֑וֹ וְ֝כִסְא֗וֹ כִּימֵ֥י שָׁמָֽיִם׃

passages.text: If his sons forsake My law and do not walk in My judgments, if they violate My statutes and fail to keep My commandments, I will attend to their transgression with the rod, and to their iniquity with stripes.
passages.sermon:
God made a covenant with David and his descendants.
God gave David’s sons His law.
God gave them His judgments.
If David’s sons abandon God’s law, God will notice.
If they do not follow God’s judgments, God will respond.
If they break God’s statutes, God will see it.
If they do not keep God’s commandments, God will act.
God will punish their wrongdoing with a rod.
God will punish their iniquity with stripes.
passages.original: אִם־ יַֽעַזְב֣וּ בָ֭נָיו תּוֹרָתִ֑י וּ֝בְמִשְׁפָּטַ֗י לֹ֣א יֵלֵכֽוּן׃ אִם־ חֻקֹּתַ֥י יְחַלֵּ֑לוּ וּ֝מִצְוֺתַ֗י לֹ֣א יִשְׁמֹֽרוּ׃ וּפָקַדְתִּ֣י בְשֵׁ֣בֶט פִּשְׁעָ֑ם וּבִנְגָעִ֥ים עֲוֺנָֽם׃

passages.text: But I will not withdraw My loving devotion from him, nor ever betray My faithfulness.
passages.sermon:
God speaks about David, His chosen king.
God promises to remain faithful to David.
God says, “I will not take away My loving devotion from David.
I will not betray My faithfulness to him.”
passages.original: וְ֭חַסְדִּי לֹֽא־ אָפִ֣יר מֵֽעִמּ֑וֹ וְלֹֽא־ אֲ֝שַׁקֵּ֗ר בֶּאֱמוּנָתִֽי׃

passages.text: I will not violate My covenant or alter the utterance of My lips.
passages.sermon:
God speaks here.
God makes a promise.
God says, “I will not break My covenant.
I will not change what I have spoken.
My words will remain true.
My promise will stand.”
passages.original: לֹא־ אֲחַלֵּ֥ל בְּרִיתִ֑י וּמוֹצָ֥א שְׂ֝פָתַ֗י לֹ֣א אֲשַׁנֶּֽה׃

passages.text: Once and for all I have sworn by My holiness— I will not lie to David— his offspring shall endure forever, and his throne before Me like the sun, like the moon, established forever, a faithful witness in the sky.” Selah Now, however, You have spurned and rejected him; You are enraged by Your anointed one.
passages.sermon:
God speaks in this passage.
God swears by His holiness.
God makes a promise to David.
God says, “I will not lie to David.”
God says, “David’s descendants will last forever.”
God says, “David’s throne will stand before Me like the sun.”
God says, “David’s throne will be established forever like the moon.”
God says, “The moon is a faithful witness in the sky.”
Selah.
Now the people speak to God.
They say, “But You have rejected and spurned him.”
They say, “You are angry with Your anointed one.”
passages.original: אַ֭חַת נִשְׁבַּ֣עְתִּי בְקָדְשִׁ֑י אִֽם־ לְדָוִ֥ד אֲכַזֵּֽב׃ זַ֭רְעוֹ לְעוֹלָ֣ם יִהְיֶ֑ה וְכִסְא֖וֹ כַשֶּׁ֣מֶשׁ נֶגְדִּֽי׃ כְּ֭יָרֵחַ יִכּ֣וֹן עוֹלָ֑ם וְעֵ֥ד בַּ֝שַּׁ֗חַק נֶאֱמָ֥ן סֶֽלָה׃ וְאַתָּ֣ה זָ֭נַחְתָּ וַתִּמְאָ֑ס הִ֝תְעַבַּ֗רְתָּ עִם־ מְשִׁיחֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: You have renounced the covenant with Your servant and sullied his crown in the dust.
passages.sermon:
God made a covenant with His servant David.
God has now rejected this covenant.
God has brought David’s crown down to the ground.
God has made David’s crown dirty in the dust.
passages.original: נֵ֭אַרְתָּה בְּרִ֣ית עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ חִלַּ֖לְתָּ לָאָ֣רֶץ נִזְרֽוֹ׃

passages.text: You have broken down all his walls; You have reduced his strongholds to rubble.
passages.sermon: God broke down all his walls.\r\nGod reduced his strongholds to rubble.
passages.original: פָּרַ֥צְתָּ כָל־ גְּדֵרֹתָ֑יו שַׂ֖מְתָּ מִבְצָרָ֣יו מְחִתָּה׃

passages.text: All who pass by plunder him; he has become a reproach to his neighbors.
passages.sermon:
All who pass by take what belongs to him.
They plunder him.
He has become a disgrace to his neighbors.
His neighbors see him with shame.
passages.original: שַׁ֭סֻּהוּ כָּל־ עֹ֣בְרֵי דָ֑רֶךְ הָיָ֥ה חֶ֝רְפָּ֗ה לִשְׁכֵנָֽיו׃

passages.text: You have exalted the right hand of his foes; You have made all his enemies rejoice.
passages.sermon:
God acted with power.
God lifted up the right hand of his enemies.
God gave strength to his foes.
God caused all his enemies to rejoice.
passages.original: הֲ֭רִימוֹתָ יְמִ֣ין צָרָ֑יו הִ֝שְׂמַ֗חְתָּ כָּל־ אוֹיְבָֽיו׃

passages.text: You have bent the edge of his sword and have not sustained him in battle.
passages.sermon: God acts with power and authority.\r\nGod bends the edge of his sword.\r\nGod does not support him in battle.
passages.original: אַף־ תָּ֭שִׁיב צ֣וּר חַרְבּ֑וֹ וְלֹ֥א הֲ֝קֵימֹת֗וֹ בַּמִּלְחָמָֽה׃

passages.text: You have ended his splendor and cast his throne to the ground.
passages.sermon: God acted with power.\r\nGod ended his splendor.\r\nGod threw his throne to the ground.
passages.original: הִשְׁבַּ֥תָּ מִטְּהָר֑וֹ וְ֝כִסְא֗וֹ לָאָ֥רֶץ מִגַּֽרְתָּה׃

passages.text: You have cut short the days of his youth; You have covered him with shame. Selah How long, O LORD? Will You hide Yourself forever? Will Your wrath keep burning like fire?
passages.sermon:
God, you have cut short the days of his youth.
You have covered him with shame.
Selah.
O LORD, how long will this last?
Will you hide yourself forever?
Will your anger burn like fire without end?
passages.original: הִ֭קְצַרְתָּ יְמֵ֣י עֲלוּמָ֑יו הֶֽעֱטִ֨יתָ עָלָ֖יו בּוּשָׁ֣ה סֶֽלָה׃ עַד־ מָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה תִּסָּתֵ֣ר לָנֶ֑צַח תִּבְעַ֖ר כְּמוֹ־ אֵ֣שׁ חֲמָתֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: Remember the briefness of my lifespan! For what futility You have created all men!
passages.sermon:
The psalmist speaks to God.
The psalmist asks God to remember something important.
The psalmist says his life is very short.
He says, “Remember how brief my life is.”
He says that God created all people.
He says God made all people for a short and empty life.
He says, “For what futility You have created all men.”
passages.original: זְכָר־ אֲנִ֥י מֶה־ חָ֑לֶד עַל־ מַה־ שָּׁ֝֗וְא בָּרָ֥אתָ כָל־ בְּנֵי־ אָדָֽם׃

passages.text: What man can live and never see death? Can he deliver his soul from the power of Sheol? Selah Where, O Lord, is Your loving devotion of old, which You faithfully swore to David?
passages.sermon:
No man can live and never see death.
No one can escape death.
No one can save his soul from the power of the grave.
O Lord, where is Your loving devotion from the past?
You swore Your faithfulness to David.
You promised David with Your faithfulness.
passages.original: מִ֤י גֶ֣בֶר יִֽ֭חְיֶה וְלֹ֣א יִרְאֶה־ מָּ֑וֶת יְמַלֵּ֨ט נַפְשׁ֖וֹ מִיַּד־ שְׁא֣וֹל סֶֽלָה׃ אַיֵּ֤ה׀ חֲסָדֶ֖יךָ הָרִאשֹׁנִ֥ים׀ אֲדֹנָ֑י נִשְׁבַּ֥עְתָּ לְ֝דָוִ֗ד בֶּאֱמוּנָתֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: Remember, O Lord, the reproach of Your servants, which I bear in my heart from so many people— how Your enemies have taunted, O LORD, and have mocked every step of Your anointed one!
passages.sermon:
O Lord, remember the shame of Your servants.
I carry this shame in my heart.
Many people have caused this shame.
Your enemies, O Lord, have mocked us.
They have mocked every step of Your anointed one.
passages.original: זְכֹ֣ר אֲ֭דֹנָי חֶרְפַּ֣ת עֲבָדֶ֑יךָ שְׂאֵתִ֥י בְ֝חֵיקִ֗י כָּל־ רַבִּ֥ים עַמִּֽים׃ אֲשֶׁ֤ר חֵרְפ֖וּ אוֹיְבֶ֥יךָ׀ יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר חֵ֝רְפ֗וּ עִקְּב֥וֹת מְשִׁיחֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: Blessed be the LORD forever! Amen and amen.
passages.sermon: The LORD is blessed forever.\r\nAmen.\r\nAmen.
passages.original: בָּר֖וּךְ יְהוָ֥ה לְ֝עוֹלָ֗ם אָ֘מֵ֥ן׀ וְאָמֵֽן׃
